credit: Photos: John Leyes / Bay Area Media
how_to_add: Drop a new original into a staging folder, add a record to PHOTOS in tools/optimize_media.py (filename, description, suggested_section, placements, alt text), then run: python3 tools/optimize_media.py. publish.py reads media.json, so the next brief refresh will pick up new placements without editing the HTML by hand.
